title: BAI Announces Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course provides advanced training for Indian badminton coaches at national centers, enhancing coaching quality across the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is organizing a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: New Regulations Issued for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations govern a key domestic tournament, directly impacting Indian players and state associations.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and procedures for participating teams.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Changed for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: A change in the women's doubles pair for the selection trials directly affects India's representation at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced a change in the women's doubles pair designated for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Begins in Guwahati
indian_angle: This coaching camp is crucial for preparing India's young talent for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 has commenced at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BAI Adopts 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This rule change will significantly impact how junior domestic ranking tournaments and national championships are played in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
